tagline.en: US-number MVNO for Chinese in America — student $1 first month, works in China
tagline.zh: 面向在美华人的美国号虚商：学生认证首月1美元，中国可用

description.en: Panda Mobile (pandamobile.com) is a US MVNO advertising "the nation's largest 5G network" (consistent with T-Mobile, unnamed officially) with eSIM/physical SIM, no SSN or credit check. Plans Lite $15 / Starter $25 / Unlimited $35 per month; OnePool data shared between US and China (China capped 5GB/mo on promos). WiFi Calling gives free calls/texts while in China; US number issued before arrival. Student verification unlocks $1 first month promos.
description.zh: 熊猫移动（pandamobile.com）是美国虚商，官方口径「全美最大 5G 网络」（与 T-Mobile 特征相符但官方未点名），eSIM/实体卡均可、无 SSN、不查信用。套餐：Lite 15 / Starter 25 / Unlimited 35 美元/月；OnePool 流量美国与中国共享（促销期中国每月上限 5GB）。WiFi Calling 令在中国期间免费通话短信；赴美前即可先拿美国号。学生认证可解锁首月 1 美元促销。

details.en:
Panda Mobile targets Chinese students and workers heading to the US: you get a US number before arrival, bilingual (Mandarin) support including WeChat, no SSN/credit check, no contract. Official plans (2026-09): Lite $15/mo, Starter $25/mo (promo $23.75), Unlimited $35/mo (promo $33.25), Unlimited Plus flash-sale $45/3 months. OnePool data works in both the US and China (China-side capped at 5GB/month during the 3-month promo). WiFi Calling keeps calls/texts free while physically in China; higher plans include free international calls to 229+ countries.

Student route: EDU-email verification via studentoffers.co unlocks Student Starter $15 / Unlimited $25 and a limited-time $1 first month on the top student tier (Instagram/studentoffers promos — confirm at checkout). Referral: $8 per friend, unlimited.

Community single-user hands-on (2026-09, unverified): landing IP in the US on T-Mobile, ~5–10GB free data with the $1 student opening, unlimited SMS/calls for that month; second month reverts to full price — effectively a one-month throwaway. IP quality good (T-Mobile US).
details.zh:
熊猫移动瞄准赴美中国学生与务工者：出发前先拿美国号、中英双语客服（含微信）、无 SSN、不查信用、无合约。官方套餐（2026-09）：Lite 15、Starter 25（促销 23.75）、Unlimited 35（促销 33.25）美元/月，Unlimited Plus 闪购 45 美元/3 个月。OnePool 流量美中共享（3 个月促销期内中国侧每月上限 5GB）。人在中国时 WiFi Calling 通话短信免费；高档套餐含 229+ 国免费国际通话。

学生通道：EDU 邮箱认证（studentoffers.co）解锁学生 Starter 15 / Unlimited 25 美元，最高学生档限时首月 1 美元（Instagram/studentoffers 促销，下单时确认）。推荐返利每名好友 8 美元、不限量。

社区单用户实测（2026-09，未核实）：美国 T-Mobile 落地 IP，1 美元学生开卡带 5–10GB 免费流量+当月无限短信通话；第二个月恢复原价——实质是月抛卡。IP 质量好（美国 T-Mobile）。

bestFor.en: Chinese students/workers wanting a US number ready before landing, cheaply for month one.
bestFor.zh: 想落地前先备好美国号、首月低成本试水的留学生/务工者。
